changes.label: CarrierProviderAdapter
changes.reason: Host v2 explicitly does not own execution or deployment truth; placement realization must bind to the natural carrier/provider owner instead.

stack.owns: desired placement and semantic AgentInstance readiness
stable local carrier entrypoint, release admission fence, immutable release delegation
provider-specific birth/reconcile semantics and non-idempotent effect fencing
browser substrate lifecycle, capacity and health

excludedAuthority.HostV2: semantic continuity and collaboration only; no placement/process execution authority
excludedAuthority.Runtime: physical Job/Attempt execution; not used by Agent Automation placement in R4

readinessSemantics.READY: the provider occurrence has durable bound materialization (or provider-declared ready-confirmed); this is provisioning readiness, not proof that every later invocation will pass provider/auth/tool admission
readinessSemantics.AMBIGUOUS: provider effect may have crossed a non-idempotent boundary and must reconcile rather than redispatch
readinessSemantics.HUMAN_REQUIRED: provider reports a pre-SEND human-verification gate; Agent Service must not cross it automatically
readinessSemantics.PRE_EFFECT_FAILED: provider proves SEND was not crossed; the same effect identity may be safely re-entered
readinessSemantics.UNRECORDED: no provider materialization attempt is recorded

retirement.reason: current Agent Automation public carrier has no provider-conversation retirement operation
